args.body:
Hi Alice,

I received your request about the resume template. I was able to access the resume templates website (www.resume-templates.com) and the download links page, but I encountered some policy restrictions when trying to directly download the PDF files from resume-templates-portal.com.

I'm currently exploring alternative ways to get the template for you. Would you like me to:
1. Try downloading from a different source?
2. Send you a different resume template that I might have access to?
3. Provide guidance on how you can download it yourself?

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.

Best regards,
Emma
